create_MjViewerBasic: create a MjViewerBasic instance to display a MuJoCo simulation with mouse-controlled camera
render_MjViewerBasic: render the current simulation state to the screen by calling the render method in a loop
create_MjViewer: create a MjViewer instance to display a MuJoCo simulation with keyboard controls and video recording
record_video_MjViewer: record a video of the MuJoCo simulation by pressing V key in the MjViewer window
capture_frame_MjViewer: capture a screenshot of the current simulation frame by pressing T key in the MjViewer window
